comment: What must not silently disappear from brandreport. `prose` names guardrails no code enforces; `split` declares which half of the skill is deterministic; `baseline` names the offline, $0 checks pinned against a real run.

prose.pattern: Never attribute unverified content: nothing reaches the repo
prose.rationale: The one rule. It is the reason this skill exists rather than a prompt; lose the line and the skill becomes a generic assistant with extra steps.

prose.pattern: Never claim a result you did not observe
prose.rationale: Honesty about what was verified is the whole house contract. A skill that reports success it did not witness is worse than one that reports nothing.

prose.pattern: never ask about anything in it
prose.rationale: Two questions maximum is only achievable because detection already answered the rest. Asking about a detectable signal is the UX failure that makes a skill feel like a form.

deterministic.step: create the run layout for a subject
file each fetched artifact with provenance and identity status
table the corpus and its confirmed/unconfirmed split
enforce the attribution gate before anything renders
render the press-styled HTML report offline from the snapshot

nondeterministic.step: the blind discovery itself — which searches to run, which hits to follow, when coverage is enough
nondeterministic.why: no file records where a person exists online; the search plan is invented per subject and adapts to what each round surfaces

nondeterministic.step: identity corroboration — deciding a hit is the same person
nondeterministic.why: cross-links, shared handles and bio overlap are read and weighed, not pattern-matched; the gate only checks the decision was recorded, the model makes it

nondeterministic.step: the brand analysis — themes, consistency across platforms, gaps, how a stranger would read this person
nondeterministic.why: judgment about impression and coherence that no snapshot states

_baseline_comment: Pinned against a real run of this skill, never a synthetic fixture. Offline and $0 by construction: no network, no model, so CI cannot spend and cannot flake.

baseline.update_command: node scripts/brandreport.js report --run evals/fixtures/nate-swenson --out <dir>/report.html && skillfactory freeze --skill brandreport --from <dir> --command 'node scripts/brandreport.js report --run evals/fixtures/nate-swenson --out $OUT/report.html' --trap-command 'node scripts/brandreport.js gate --run evals/fixtures/gate-trap'
baseline.rationale: the report silently dropping a section or a source while still looking complete; the renderer drifting; provenance ceasing to thread from claim to snapshot — pinned against a real run on the maintainer's own name, frozen — the subject's own public artifacts kept, every same-name stranger replaced by an invented one reproducing the shape (gmailtriage precedent), then gate + report re-run over the frozen snapshot and byte-compared.

baseline.update_command: edit evals/fixtures/gate-trap by hand — its only defects must stay a dangling citation and an unconfirmed item cited as confirmed
baseline.rationale: the attribution gate weakening until unverified content reaches the report — the one rule ceasing to be enforced by code — pinned against a findings file whose only defect is one claim citing a snapshot that does not exist, and a variant where an unconfirmed item is cited as confirmed.

baseline.update_command: invent replacements in evals/fixtures/*/snapshots — never copy a real same-name person in, even pseudonymised
baseline.rationale: a corpus refresh leaking a real same-name person's data into a public repo — every unconfirmed snapshot must live on a reserved .example domain and reference no real host, which catches a leaked identity without committing a blocklist of real identities.
